effects: Takes exactly `assets` cbBTC from the signer into the vault (ERC4626._deposit: safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)).

Mints vault shares (recbBTC) to `receiver`. The number of shares comes from the vault's stored totals (deposit: _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Floor)), and there is no minimum.
The vault then supplies the cbBTC to Morpho Blue markets. This is the vault's own transfer and does not change what the signer gets.
formats.shown: "Deposit", with the cbBTC amount, the share ticker recbBTC and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the intent "Deposit" has no interpolatedIntent naming the amount, the asset or the share recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit format: "intent": "Deposit" and no interpolatedIntent. Case 0: the reader was unsure "Which contract receives the cbBTC".
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent, e.g. "Deposit {assets} into the recbBTC vault, shares to {receiver}".

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown and has no minimum, because it comes from the vault's price.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Floor). Case 0: the signer received 15200000000000 recbBTC, but the screen shows only the ticker.
findings.fix: None from calldata. The ERC4626 deposit has no minShares parameter.

cases.notes: The cbBTC out (0.0000152) matches the screen. The recbBTC in has its asset and recipient on screen but no amount, because the amount comes from the vault's storage.

effects: Takes cbBTC from the signer. The amount is computed from the vault's stored totals and rounded up (mint: _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, ..., Ceil)). It is not in the calldata, and only the signer's allowance caps it.
formats.shown: "Mint", with a fixed line "Deposit asset: cbBTC", the share amount and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: mint: the cbBTC amount taken from the signer is not shown and has no maximum in the calldata.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); then _deposit runs safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, ...). The descriptor field 'Deposit asset' shows only the constant "cbBTC".
findings.fix: None from calldata. The ERC4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter. A label like 'Pays in (amount set by vault price)' would make this clear.

findings.title: mint: the intent "Mint" does not say that cbBTC leaves the signer, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint: "intent": "Mint", interpolatedIntent absent. The cbBTC payment appears only as a raw constant field 'Deposit asset'.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Deposit cbBTC to mint shares" and an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paid in cbBTC".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns from `owner` the shares needed to cover `assets`, rounded up (withdraw: _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, ..., Ceil)).
When the signer is not `owner`, spends that many shares of the owner's allowance to the signer (ERC4626._withdraw: _spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares)).
formats.shown: "Withdraw", with the exact cbBTC amount, the recipient and the owner whose shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown, because it comes from the vault's price.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _burn(owner, shares).
findings.fix: None from calldata. The ERC4626 withdraw has no maxShares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent "Withdraw" has no interpolatedIntent with the amount and the recipient.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver} from {owner}'s shares".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares (recbBTC) from `owner`. When the signer is not the owner, it also spends the owner's allowance to the signer.
Sends cbBTC to `receiver`. The amount is computed from the vault's stored totals and rounded down (redeem: _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, ..., Floor)), and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: "Redeem", with the share amount, the recipient and the owner. Nothing names the asset that comes back.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says that cbBTC is the asset sent to the receiver.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets). The descriptor's redeem fields are only shares, receiver and owner. The mint format does show the constant underlyingTicker, but redeem does not.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} or say cbBTC in the intent.

findings.title: redeem: the cbBTC amount received is not shown and has no minimum, because it comes from the vault's price.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor).
findings.fix: None from calldata. The ERC4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter.

findings.title: redeem: the intent "Redeem" has no interpolatedIntent and does not say what comes back.
findings.fix: Use an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for cbBTC to {receiver}".
